title: Kuro's Warning
summary: Approaching the fortified Mapo Bridge, Kuro warns Ha-Jun of the ancient rule of the Abyss: every time a Sovereign unleashes absolute authority, the seal on the Abyssal Gates weakens.

panels.shot: stormy han river and mapo bridge wide shot
panels.action: Torrential rain lashes the dark, swollen waters of the Han River; Mapo Bridge is ablaze with emergency searchlights.
panels.prose_en: Torrential rain lashes the dark, swollen waters of the Han River; Mapo Bridge is ablaze with emergency searchlights.
panels.prose_hi: Haan nadi ke gahre, ufante pani mein musladhar baarish ho rahi hai; mepo bridge aapatkalin sarchlight se jagmaga raha hai.

panels.shot: armored bureau carriers sealing both ends of bridge
panels.action: Eight heavy armored vehicles form an impenetrable barricade; barbed razor wire stretches across all lanes.
panels.prose_en: Eight heavy armored vehicles form an impenetrable barricade; barbed razor wire stretches across all lanes.
panels.prose_hi: Aath bhari bakhtarband vahan ek abhedy morchabandi banate han; kantile razr taar sabhi galiyon mein faile hue han.

panels.shot: school buses trapped in center of bridge
panels.action: Twenty yellow school buses parked bumper-to-bumper; terrified children pressing tear-streaked faces to foggy windows.
panels.prose_en: Twenty yellow school buses parked bumper-to-bumper; terrified children pressing tear-streaked faces to foggy windows.
panels.prose_hi: Bis pili school basen bampar-tu-bampar khadi thin; dare hue bacche aansuon se bhare chehron ko dhundhli khidkiyon ke samne daba rahe han.

panels.shot: ha-jun walking down empty highway toward bridge
panels.action: Ha-Jun walks down the center double-yellow line, raindrops parting around an invisible mana envelope.
panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun walks down the center double-yellow line, raindrops parting around an invisible mana envelope.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-jun kendra ki dohri-pili rekha se neeche chalta hai, baarish ki bunden ek adrishya maina lifafe ke charon or failti han.

panels.shot: kuro gliding low over ha-jun head
panels.action: Kuro glides three feet above him, red eyes surveying the fortified bridge with ancient solemnity.

dialogue.speaker: kuro
dialogue.text: Ha-Jun... Ek aakhri warning sun lo.

panels.prose_en: Kuro glides three feet above him, red eyes surveying the fortified bridge with ancient solemnity.
panels.prose_hi: Kuro usse teen feet upar udta hai, lal aankhen prachin gambhirta ke saath kiledar pul ka nirikshan karti han.

panels.shot: ha-jun glancing up through wet fringe
panels.action: Ha-Jun keeps walking without breaking stride: 'Kya warning, Kuro?'

dialogue.speaker: hajun
dialogue.text: Jo bhi ho, main peeche nahi hatunga.

panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun keeps walking without breaking stride: 'Kya warning, Kuro?'.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-jun bina ruke chalta rahata hai: 'kya chetavani hai, kuro?'.

panels.shot: kuro speaking of the abyssal gate resonance
panels.action: Kuro explains: 'Tumhare teen Basic Relics fully harmonised hain. Agar tumne 100% mana blast kiya...'

dialogue.speaker: kuro
dialogue.text: Toh Gangnam ke underground Abyssal Gate par pressure padega. Demon Realm ki attention attract hogi.

panels.prose_en: Kuro explains: 'Tumhare teen Basic Relics fully harmonised hain. Agar tumne 100% mana blast kiya...'.
panels.prose_hi: Kuro batate han: 'tumhare teen basic avashesh puri tarah se samanjasyapurn han. agar tumne 100% man blast kiya...'.

panels.shot: vision of titanic demon lord eyes in the void
panels.action: A brief psychic flash of Demon King Malgath's six crimson eyes opening in the molten Abyss.

dialogue.text: Sovereign ki har pukaar... Abyss ke sabse khatarnak darindo ko jagati hai.

panels.prose_en: A brief psychic flash of Demon King Malgath's six crimson eyes opening in the molten Abyss.
panels.prose_hi: Pighle hue rasatal mein khulne wali danav raja malgath ki chhah lal aankhon ki ek sankshipt mansik jhalak.

panels.shot: ha-jun tightening fists
panels.action: Ha-Jun's bone gauntlet chimes: 'Main control mein rahunga. Sirf target-specific precision use karunga.'

dialogue.speaker: hajun
dialogue.text: Mujhe destructive beast nahi banna... Mujhe surgical warrior banna hai.

panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun's bone gauntlet chimes: 'Main control mein rahunga. Sirf target-specific precision use karunga.'.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-jun ki haddi ki ghanti bajti hai: 'main niyantran mein rahunga. keval lakshya-vishisht parishuddhata ka upyog karunga.'

panels.shot: searchlights from watchtower locking onto ha-jun
panels.action: Four 100,000-lumen searchlights swivel simultaneously, trapping Ha-Jun in a blinding cross of white light.
panels.prose_en: Four 100,000-lumen searchlights swivel simultaneously, trapping Ha-Jun in a blinding cross of white light.
panels.prose_hi: Char 100,000-lumen sarchlight ek saath ghumti han, ha-jun ko safed roshni ke ek chakachaundh cross mein fansa deti han.

panels.shot: bureau snipers screaming into comms
panels.action: Hunter snipers on carrier roofs shout through tactical headsets: 'TARGET SPOTTED! HA-JUN KANG IS ON FOOT!'

dialogue.speaker: sniper_comm
dialogue.text: TARGET APPROACHING ON FOOT! CLEARANCE TO FIRE!

panels.prose_en: Hunter snipers on carrier roofs shout through tactical headsets: 'TARGET SPOTTED! HA-JUN KANG IS ON FOOT!'.
panels.prose_hi: Vahak chhaton par shikari nishanebaj samrik headset ke madhyam se chillate han: 'lakshya dekha gaya!' ha-jun kang paidal hai!'

panels.shot: director kang on carrier roof raising hand
panels.action: Director Kang holds up a gloved hand to pause the snipers: 'Wait. Let him enter the killzone.'

dialogue.speaker: director_kang
dialogue.text: Use dekhne do ki uski aashao ka kya anjaam hota hai.

panels.prose_en: Director Kang holds up a gloved hand to pause the snipers: 'Wait. Let him enter the killzone.'.
panels.prose_hi: Nirdeshak kang ne bandukdhariyon ko rokne ke liye dastaane wala haath uthaya: 'ruko. use kiljon mein pravesh karne do.'

panels.shot: captain baek stepping forward on bridge tarmac
panels.action: Captain Baek walks forward to the fifty-meter mark, gripping his Eclipse Greatsword with both hands.
panels.prose_en: Captain Baek walks forward to the fifty-meter mark, gripping his Eclipse Greatsword with both hands.
panels.prose_hi: Capton bake apne aclips gratusward ko donon hathon se pakadkar pachas meter ke nishan tak aage badhte han.

panels.shot: ha-jun stopping twenty meters away from baek
panels.action: Ha-Jun halts; rain splashes between the two warriors under the glare of searchlights.
panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun halts; rain splashes between the two warriors under the glare of searchlights.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-jun rukta hai; sarchlight ki chakachaundh mein donon yoddhaon ke beech baarish ki fuharen pad rahi han.

panels.shot: baek looking at ha-jun mended arm in disbelief
panels.action: Baek's eyes widen through his visor: 'Tumhara hath... Barah ghante pehle compound fracture tha!'

dialogue.speaker: captain_baek
dialogue.text: Yeh kaise possible hai?! Tumhari haddiyan jud chuki hain?!

panels.prose_en: Baek's eyes widen through his visor: 'Tumhara hath... Barah ghante pehle compound fracture tha!'.
panels.prose_hi: Bak ki aankhen uske chhajje se failti han: 'tumhara hath... barah ghante pehle compound fracture tha!'.

panels.shot: ha-jun raising left bone gauntlet
panels.action: Ha-Jun flexes his ivory gauntlet; it gleams with cold, diamond-hard luster in the searchlights.

dialogue.speaker: hajun
dialogue.text: Tumne kaha tha na, Captain... Dushman par reham karna gunaah hai?

panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun flexes his ivory gauntlet; it gleams with cold, diamond-hard luster in the searchlights.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-jun ne apni hathi daant ki chunauti ka samna kiya; yah sarchlight mein thandi, heere jaisi kathor chamak ke saath chamakta hai.

panels.shot: ha-jun voice ringing with calm authority
panels.action: Ha-Jun continues: 'Main yahan reham mangne nahi aaya. Main tumhe sach batane aaya hoon.'

dialogue.speaker: hajun
dialogue.text: Director Kang tumhe use kar raha hai, Baek.

panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun continues: 'Main yahan reham mangne nahi aaya. Main tumhe sach batane aaya hoon.'.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-jun aage kahte han, 'main yahan raham mangaane nahin aaya. main tumhe sach batane aaya hun.'.

panels.shot: director kang laughing mocking through loudspeaker
panels.action: Director Kang's voice booms over the speakers: 'Lies of a cornered demon! Hunters, OPEN FIRE!'
panels.prose_en: Director Kang's voice booms over the speakers: 'Lies of a cornered demon! Hunters, OPEN FIRE!'.
panels.prose_hi: Spikar par nirdeshak kang ki awaz gunjati hai: 'ek kone mein band rakshas ka jhuth! shikari, khuli aag!'.

panels.shot: fifty automatic rifles opening fire simultaneously
panels.action: Fifty heavy weapons erupt in a continuous wall of muzzle flashes, silver bullets tearing through rain.
panels.prose_en: Fifty heavy weapons erupt in a continuous wall of muzzle flashes, silver bullets tearing through rain.
panels.prose_hi: Pachas bhari hathiyar thuthan ki chamak ki ek satat deewar mein futate han, chandi ki goliya baarish se takrati han.

panels.shot: ha-jun activating sovereign blood weaving
panels.action: Ha-Jun takes half a step back, his arms moving in fluid, hypnotic Tai-Chi like circular arcs.
panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun takes half a step back, his arms moving in fluid, hypnotic Tai-Chi like circular arcs.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-jun aadha kadam peeche hatata hai, uski bhujaen golakar chaap ki tarah taral, sammohak taai-chi mein ghum rahi han.

panels.shot: spiraling vortex of crimson blood mana manifesting
panels.action: A swirling double-funnel of liquid crimson blood forms around him, rotating at 200 mph.
panels.prose_en: A swirling double-funnel of liquid crimson blood forms around him, rotating at 200 mph.
panels.prose_hi: Uske charon or 200 meal prati ghante ki gati se ghumte hue, taral lal rakt ka ek ghumta hua duble-fanal banta hai.

panels.shot: thousands of silver bullets caught in vortex
panels.action: Every single bullet is trapped in the swirling fluid stream, losing all kinetic energy instantly.
panels.prose_en: Every single bullet is trapped in the swirling fluid stream, losing all kinetic energy instantly.
panels.prose_hi: Har ek goli ghumti hui taral dhara mein fans jaati hai, jisse turant sari gatij urja nasht ho jaati hai.

panels.shot: hunters staring in absolute frozen shock
panels.action: The fifty elite hunters lower their weapons, watching thousands of bullets suspended harmlessly in red rings.

dialogue.speaker: hunter_grunt
dialogue.text: H-Hamari saari bullets hawa mein ruk gayi...!

panels.prose_en: The fifty elite hunters lower their weapons, watching thousands of bullets suspended harmlessly in red rings.
panels.prose_hi: Pachas sambhrant shikariyon ne lal chhalle mein hanirahit roop se latki hajaron goliyon ko dekhte hue, apne hathiyar neeche kar die.

panels.shot: ha-jun flicking fingers forward
panels.action: With a gentle flick of his open palm, Ha-Jun reverses the vortex spin.
panels.prose_en: With a gentle flick of his open palm, Ha-Jun reverses the vortex spin.
panels.prose_hi: Apni khuli hatheli ke halke jhatke se, ha-jun bhanwar spin ko ulat deta hai.

panels.shot: thousands of bullets launched backward at non-lethal targets
panels.action: All thousands of captured bullets rocket backward, slicing cleanly through the hunter rifle barrels and car tires.
panels.prose_en: All thousands of captured bullets rocket backward, slicing cleanly through the hunter rifle barrels and car tires.
panels.prose_hi: Pakdi gai sabhi hajaron goliyan shikari rifle barrel aur car ke tyron ko saf-saf kaatati hui peeche ki or rocket karti han.

panels.shot: all fifty rifles sheared in half simultaneously
panels.action: Every hunter is left holding a smoking broken receiver; all eight armored vehicle tires deflate.
panels.prose_en: Every hunter is left holding a smoking broken receiver; all eight armored vehicle tires deflate.
panels.prose_hi: Pratyek shikari ke haath mein dhunaa nikalta hua toota hua receiver rah jata hai; sabhi aath bakhtarband vahanon ke tyre kharab ho gaye.

panels.shot: not a single hunter injured
panels.action: The hunters look down at their unharmed hands in stunned bewilderment: zero casualties.
panels.prose_en: The hunters look down at their unharmed hands in stunned bewilderment: zero casualties.
panels.prose_hi: Shikari stabdh hokar apne surakshit hathon ko neeche dekhte han: koi hatahat nahin.

panels.shot: captain baek sword tip lowering slightly
panels.action: Captain Baek stares at Ha-Jun with profound realization: 'Usne chaaha hota toh sabko maar sakta tha...'

dialogue.speaker: captain_baek
dialogue.text: Itni lethal power ke baad bhi... Ek bhi insaan ko hurt nahi kiya.

panels.prose_en: Captain Baek stares at Ha-Jun with profound realization: 'Usne chaaha hota toh sabko maar sakta tha...'.
panels.prose_hi: Capton bak gahre ahsas ke saath ha-jun ko dekhta hai: 'usne chaha hota to sabko maar sakta tha...'.

panels.shot: min-jae voice hijacking bridge public screens
panels.action: High above on the giant bridge traffic display, Min-Jae's face cuts in over the police broadcast.

dialogue.speaker: min-jae
dialogue.text: HUNTERS! APNE SCREENS PAR DEKHO! DIRECTOR KANG KA SACH!

panels.prose_en: High above on the giant bridge traffic display, Min-Jae's face cuts in over the police broadcast.
panels.prose_hi: Vishal pul yatayat pradarshan ke upar, police prasaran ko dekhte hue min-je ka chehra cut jata hai.

panels.shot: project chimera documents flashing across giant screens
panels.action: Classified videos of Director Kang experimenting with demonic cores flash across the 50-foot display.

dialogue.text: Bureau ka jhooth... Puri city ke saamne be-parda ho gaya.

panels.prose_en: Classified videos of Director Kang experimenting with demonic cores flash across the 50-foot display.
panels.prose_hi: Nirdeshak kang ke rakshasi core ke saath prayog ke vargikrit video 50-fut display par chamakte han.
